title: Final Entropy Change
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express the total entropy change as Delta S = C_p (T_i/T_f - 1 + ln(T_f/T_i)).

title: Entropy of Body
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the change of entropy for the body as Delta S_1 = C_p ln(T_f/T_i).

title: Entropy of Reservoir
description: Important Criteria: The student must calculate the change of entropy for the reservoir as Delta S_2 = C_p (T_i - T_f)/T_f.

title: Positive Entropy Proof
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate that the total entropy change is positive using the function f(x) = x - 1 - ln(x).

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes in the calculations of Delta S_2 and the total entropy change.
